# Homebrew Rules

  

To be able to use Circle Casting you must learn it within the world.

  

Traveling 

When traveling across the world of Elementos. The map will be using a hex grid. Here are the rules for  traveling across the grid.

  

- Simple Terrain (Grasslands, Sand, Roads or Dirt Roads, BadLands): 1 day per hex.
    

  

- Rough terrains (Hills, Forests, Swamps, Sandunes): 6 days per hex.
    

  

- Difficult Terrains (Mountains, Heavy forests, Rocky hills): 11 days per hex
    

  

- Horseback removes 1/2 day of travel according to the terrain.e.g. in desert horses do not give this bonus, but does on mountain and do not for a very narrow and harmful passage on a mountain cliff.
    

  

- Water on a boat/ship, you have more food-storage. 3 hexes per day on normal weather.
    

  

- Wind in favor works like roads, removes 1/2 day of travel and adds 1 day of travel if it's against our path.
    

  

## Tweaked Spells

For bouncing reasons some of the spells work a little bit differently.

  

### Counterspell

If you are the enemy affected with a counter spell the spell slot that spell that was used is lost.

  

### Watery Sphere

Watery Sphere now causes the suffocation condition. when under its effect.

Both the Spell Wish and Simulacrum must be learned within the world meaning that you cannot learn it from just leveling up. 

  

## Pushing Beyond Limits

In this world of magic, true greatness is forged by those who dare to push past their limits. Some mages risk everything to channel power they are not yet ready to command.

Magic Action:  
As an action, you may attempt to cast a spell of a level higher than you can normally prepare or cast. You must be able to prepare or know the spell in question to attempt this. When you do, you immediately gain a level of exhaustion equal to the spell level divided by 2 rounded down. and make a Spellcasting ability check (DC = 6 + 2 × the spell’s level). 

- On a success: You cast the spell as normal taking the highest spell slot you have available, following all other casting requirements.  
      
    
- On a failure: You gain another level of exhaustion and must repeat the check until you succeed or until you die.
    

If you die in this way, your body is consumed by the unleashed magic. Only a Counterspell cast on the attempted spell can prevent this outcome.
